svg.text: One model, any data: tokens in, tokens out
Anything that can be turned into tokens can train, and be written by, one transformer.
one set of weights, trained on every kind of data together
Text, images, video and actions are inputs and outputs alike: one model can
describe a scene, plan, imagine the future and act, and each skill helps the others.
images and robot states in, a text plan out
image and instruction in, actions out
predicts the next frames along with its actions
frames and actions in, the future frames out
